==Sources==
{{Incomplete}}
While clue scrolls can be obtained from a large variety of monsters or activities, players wishing to farm a specific clue tier may wish to commit to the most efficient methods for said clue tier. Below is a non-exhaustive list of methods for obtaining medium clues.

===Eclectic implings===
Non-[[Ironman Mode|ironman]] players with money to spare may opt to purchase the [[Eclectic impling jar|impling jars]] on the [[Grand Exchange]] for the absolute fastest method of obtaining medium clues.

Camping [[Eclectic impling]] spawn points in [[Puro-Puro]] offers the (sans buying the implings from other players) fastest medium clues in the game; the minimum requirements are 50 [[Hunter]], the [[Lost City]] [[quest]], [[Impling jar|Impling jars]], and an [[Insect net]] (as you cannot bare-hand implings in Puro-Puro.) The optimal requirements are 93 Hunter and a [[Magic insect net]] for 100% catch rate, 50 [[Magic]] and [[A Kingdom Divided]] for [[Dark Lure]], and the [[Huntsman's kit]] to withdraw jars from when the ones in the inventory break. [[Implings]] are '''not''' affected by the clue chance buff from [[Combat Achievements]].

Eclectic implings have a 1 in 25 chance of containing a medium clue, and under perfect conditions it is possible to catch one impling every 9 ticks (including respawn time) thus with high focus it is possible to catch over ~650 Eclectics per hour. This puts the clue rate at ~26 medium clues, however under real conditions the clue rate will vary.


===Pickpocketing gnomes===
Various [[gnomes]] throughout the world can be thieved from with the minimum requirement of 75 [[Thieving]], however a higher Thieving level is recommended due to the fairly poor success rate (56% base at 75 vs 68% at 99) at lower levels, as is the completion of the [[Ardougne diary]] hard tier for the increased thieving success perk. 47 [[Magic]] and completion of [[A Kingdom Divided]] gives the player access to [[Shadow Veil]] which can be combined with a [[Dodgy necklace]] for a ~36% chance to avoid the stun from being caught. Upon being caught the player will take a small amount of damage, thus a method of healing is required.

Gnomes offer medium clues at a rate of 1 in 150, and it is possible to pick a pocket every 2 ticks, and every time the player is caught they will be stunned for 10 ticks. Assuming 99 Thieving with Ardougne diary completed, wearing the [[Thieving cape]] and using both Shadow Veil and Dodgy necklaces the player can expect to succeed 82.81% of the time, ~10.96% attempts leading to a full stun for 10 ticks, and the remaining ~6.23% avoiding the stun but still losing 2 ticks. This puts the theoretical perfect time per roll at an average of ~4.342 ticks per hour, or ~1380 rolls coming out to ~9.2 medium clues per hour.

The medium [[Combat Achievements]] increase the likelihood of receiving a medium clue from gnomes by 5%.

===Cannoning guards===
Using the [[Dwarf multicannon]] to mass-farm the [[Guards]] of [[Falador]] is another popular method, with the only requirements being the [[Dwarf Cannon]] quest, a [[Dwarf multicannon|multicannon]] and a supply of [[Steel cannonball|Steel cannonballs]].

Guards offer medium clues at a rate of 1 in 128, which can be boosted to a rate of 1 in 100 through the buffs offered by the [[Falador diary]] and [[Combat Achievements]] medium tier.

Information about the efficacy of this method is pending.
